{{Quote|Not realising that the ideology that had once produced stormtroopers armor was still producing stormtroopers. Chancellor Lanever Villecham resolutely refused to heed the warnings from the likes of General Leia Organa as to what was about to happen.|Beaumont Kin, The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire|<ref name="Rise and Fall" />}}
'''Lanever Villecham''' was a [[Tarsunt]] [[Gender|male]] [[Politics|politician]] who served as the [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] of the [[New Republic]]. Villecham, a delegate to the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] from the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Tarsunt (planet)|Tarsunt]], was a believer in the peace initiatives that the New Republic carried out after the signing of the [[Galactic Concordance]] with the [[Galactic Empire]] at the [[Battle of Jakku|end]] of the [[Galactic Civil War]].

As such, he focused his [[time|term]] in office on forging agreeable trade relations between the New Republic and the neutral [[Star system|systems]] in the [[Trans-Hydian Borderlands]], but despite the insistence of [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and the [[Resistance]], did not consider the [[Cold War|emerging]] [[First Order]] to be a threat. He [[Death|perished]] on [[Hosnian Prime]] when the planet, then serving as the [[capital]] of the Republic, was [[Hosnian Cataclysm|destroyed]] by the First Order's [[Starkiller Base]] [[superweapon]].

==Biography==
[[File:Korr_Sella_final_moments.jpg|thumb|left|250px|Chancellor Villecham's last moments before he is killed by the Starkiller Base superweapon.]]
Lanever Villecham hailed from the [[Mid Rim Territories|Mid Rim]] [[planet]] [[Tarsunt (planet)|Tarsunt]],<ref name="Geektionary" /> serving as a delegate to the [[New Republic Senate|Galactic Senate]] of the [[New Republic]], representing the [[Tarsunt system]].<ref name="TFA VD" /> In [[32 ABY]],<ref name="32 BBY date">{{Databank|chancellor-villecham|Chancellor Villecham}} states that Lanever Villecham became [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] of the [[New Republic]] two years before the [[Attack on Tuanul]], which corresponds to [[32 BBY]] per ''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]''.</ref> during the [[New Republic Era]], Villecham was elected to serve as [[Chancellor (New Republic)|Chancellor]] of the New Republic.<ref name="Databank Villecham">{{Databank|chancellor-villecham|Chancellor Villecham}}</ref>

By [[34 ABY]], Villecham was within the second [[Standard year|year]] of his first term in office,<ref name="TFA VD" /> and characterised his chancellery by not considering the First Order in the [[Unknown Regions]] of being a serious threat,<ref name="Rise and Fall">''[[Star Wars: The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''</ref> so long they did not expand beyond their borders, as well as adhering to dictates of the [[Galactic Concordance]], a peace treaty marking the Empire's defeat to the Republic at the end of the [[Galactic Civil War]]. This stance was in contrast to the claims of [[General]] [[Leia Skywalker Organa Solo|Leia Organa]] and the paramilitary organisation she founded, the [[Resistance]], whom urged the Republic to consider military action against the First Order rising power. Instead Villecham's principle focuses was on facilitating agreeable [[trade]] relations with neutral [[star system]]s of the [[Trans-Hydian Borderlands]] and ignored the First Order all together.<ref name="TFA VD" />

Organa dispatched an [[envoy]], [[Commander]] [[Korr Sella]], to the Republic's then [[capital]] of [[Hosnian Prime]]—then hosting the New Republic Senate—to argue for a military build-up, however this action was futile<ref name="TFA VD" /> since Villecham and Sella were killed, when the First Order targeted Hosnian Prime, along with the [[Hosnian system]] with Starkiller Base. The [[superweapon]] there firing rays that [[Hosnian Cataclysm|annihilated the five planets entirely]].<ref name="Episode VII">{{Film|VII}}</ref>

The [[historian]] [[Beaumont Kin]] mentioned him in<ref name="Rise and Fall" /> his<ref name="TROS VD">''[[Star Wars: The Rise of Skywalker: The Visual Dictionary]]''</ref> [[book]] ''[[The Rise and Fall of the Galactic Empire]]''<ref name="Rise and Fall" /> in [[35 ABY]].<ref name="Date 35">{{RiseAndFallDate}}</ref> Briefly documenting Villecham chancellery during the [[Cold War|rise]] of the [[First Order]] and his refusal to heed the warnings from the likes of General Leia Organa as to what was about to happen.<ref name="Rise and Fall" />

==Personality and traits==
Lanever Villecham was a [[Tarsunt]] [[Gender|male]] with [[Color|white]] [[hair]], black [[eye]]s, and yellow skin. He was a believer in the peace initiatives of the New Republic and would not consider a renewed conflict so long as the First Order did not violate the Galactic Concordance,<ref name="TFA VD" /> which they ultimately did by destroying Hosnian Prime—costing Villecham his life.<ref name="Episode VII" />

==Behind the scenes==
Lanever Villecham first appeared in [[Star Wars: Episode VII The Force Awakens|''Star Wars'': Episode VII ''The Force Awakens'']]. While he was not identified onscreen,<ref name="Episode VII" /> his name was revealed in ''[[Star Wars: The Force Awakens: The Visual Dictionary]]'', a [[2015]] reference book by [[Lucasfilm Story Group]] member [[Pablo Hidalgo]].<ref name="TFA VD" />
